validated_baselines.scope: Accepted 2D geometry/composition Candidate 002: grounded character foot anchors, portal frame/energy alignment, shared camera transforms, stable world-space board text during zoom/pan, and the accepted revised Vex hair silhouette for this reference candidate.
validated_capabilities: Character rig-local foot anchors remain visually grounded on the shared set floor through the tested camera pan/zoom.
Portal energy remains concentric with and inherits the physical portal inner opening through the tested camera transforms.
World-space board wording remains visually attached to its board during camera zoom/pan by transforming the board and text as one rendered object.
The revised Vex hair silhouette was visually accepted for this reference candidate.
The candidate renders successfully as a 1280x720 24 FPS H.264/yuv420p MP4 under the stated conditions.
known_limitations: The Vex hair design is accepted for this reference candidate only and is not a universal character-art rule for future shows.
B1 is an 8-second geometry/composition reference, not a full long-form animation-quality baseline.
not_validated: Voice, dialogue timing, sound effects, music, and audio mixing; the candidate is intentionally silent.
Universal character scale ranges, action-safe margins, text-safe margins, full z-order rules, and reusable camera presets.

note: B1 is the first formal known-good baseline. It is intentionally scoped to the tested 2D geometry/composition behavior and does not imply that unrelated 2D, audio, business, or 3D capabilities are validated.
